# Ge Yu (余舸)

> Personal academic website of Ge Yu, Ph.D. Candidate in Finance at the Swedish House of Finance, Stockholm School of Economics (Stockholm, Sweden). Research interests: asset management, machine learning and AI, empirical asset pricing, and FinTech. On the academic job market in 2026–2027.

Contact: ge.yu@hhs.se · Office 671/674, Sveavägen 65, 113 50 Stockholm, Sweden

## Research

- Job market paper: "From Words to Portfolios: Disentangling Narrative and Reality in Mutual Fund Differentiation" (Best PhD Paper Award, 3rd AI in Finance Conference) — studies the different implications of portfolio and narrative differentiation for mutual fund fees, capital flows, and future performance; combines a transformer-based portfolio embedding model with large language model embeddings of fund prospectuses to construct two measures of mutual fund differentiation (portfolio holdings vs. prospectus narratives); the two are only weakly correlated, and the findings suggest narrative differentiation serves a marketing and pricing role, while portfolio uniqueness predicts future alpha among funds with a strong track record. Latest draft: https://geyu.me/jmp/
- Work in progress: "Generative AI, Labor, and Financial Market" (with Mariassunta Giannetti)
- Work in progress: "Attractive Curves in ETF Prices" (with Riccardo Sabbatucci)
- Work in progress: "Generative AI and the Bundling of Work Requirements" (with Tianxiang Zheng and Haofeng Zhou)
- Work in progress: "When AI Gets Nerfed: LLM Quality and Financial Markets"

## Education

- Ph.D. in Finance, Stockholm School of Economics (2021–present)
- M.S. in Applied Economics and Management, Cornell University (2019–2021)
- B.A. in Public Finance, Central University of Finance and Economics (2015–2019)
